text: Detects known vulnerabilities in container images
quote: It detects known vulnerabilities in your container image.

text: Scans lock files like Gemfile.lock and package-lock.json for known vulnerable packages
quote: Trivy will look for vulnerabilities based on lock files such as Gemfile.lock and package-lock.json.

text: Scans container images, filesystems, and git repos for exposed secrets such as passwords, API keys, and tokens; enabled by default
quote: Trivy scans any container image, filesystem and git repository to detect exposed secrets like passwords, api keys, and tokens. Secret scanning is enabled by default.

text: Provides built-in checks for misconfigurations in IaC files like Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and CloudFormation
quote: Trivy provides built-in checks to detect configuration issues in popular Infrastructure as Code files, such as: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CloudFormation, and more.

text: Scans container images for license files and gives an opinionated risk rating per license
quote: Trivy scans any container image for license files and offers an opinionated view on the risk associated with the license.

text: Generates SBOM documents in CycloneDX and SPDX formats for images and local projects
quote:
Trivy can generate the following SBOM formats.

*   [CycloneDX](#cyclonedx)
*   [SPDX](#spdx)

text: Lets users ask questions about security issues using natural language
quote: Natural Language Scanning: Ask questions about security issues in natural language

text: Can scan an entire Kubernetes cluster and produce a summary report via CLI
Detects misconfigurations in a container image's config by converting it into an equivalent Dockerfile for analysis
quote: Trivy detects misconfigurations on the configuration of container images. The image config is converted into Dockerfile and Trivy handles it as Dockerfile.

text: Caches analysis results keyed by the latest git commit hash to speed up repeat scans
quote: it stores analysis results, using the latest commit hash as the key.

text: Provides an MCP server integrating Trivy's scanning with VS Code and other MCP-enabled tools
quote: This plugin starts a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that integrates Trivy's security scanning capabilities with VS Code and other MCP-enabled tools.
